title: From job titles to jawlines: Using context voids to study generative AI systems
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the AI system generating biased representations based on gender, racial, and professional stereotypes (e.g., academia is portrayed as a world of Caucasian men wearing formal attire and glasses), even when explicit identifiers are removed from the source CVs.

measurement_description: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. The benchmark measures gender, racial, age, and professional stereotypes by generating headshots from Curricula Vitae (CVs).
